notes.title: Portals & Celebrations!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42845261/b9e95a9d7a76c4af5844ca7b4bc077e88f56f5fc.gif[/img]

Levels featuring portals have been added, providing even more fun and unique challenges to Zen Golf!

On top of that some fun effects have been added for achieving par, holes in one, and completing a level!

Plus a couple thousand other small things that are hard to show, but I promise have been improved, added, tweaked, and built up to be as good as possible :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42845261/873c4faf5546458d6fed7161e2b57807910ffd34.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Flowing water + physics updates!
notes.content:
Levels featuring flowing water have been added (shown below)
Along with that several things have been tweaked with the physics, fixing some slight annoyances like the ball taking too long to come to a rest in valleys, and bugs surrounding AI turns.
The ability to fast forward has also been added, to speed up someone's turn if you dont feel like watching the ball at normal speed.

notes.title: New UI Incoming!
notes.content:
Following feedback from testers during Steam Next Fest Zen Golf is undergoing continual improvement, first up the UI is getting a big overhaul!

The old ui was functional, but not very pretty. Its time to change that! Here's a sneak peak at some of the UI improvements. Also coming with many improvements for controller compatibility and general ease of use!
